summary: BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2025-5C37 filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that Argentic Services Company LP was appointed as successor special servicer for the Vertex HQ Mortgage Loan, replacing Situs Holdings LLC under the VRTX Trust 2025-HQ trust and servicing agreement. The loan constitutes approximately 9.4% of the issuing entity's asset pool. This is a routine servicing arrangement change for an asset-backed securitization, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or strategic review.
